messages.content: Predict the person’s route on the current leg of a virtual-reality coffee-cup collection task in an office. Two digital colleagues initially stand facing each other, with a table and a coffee cup behind them. The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

At the start of this trial, the agents begin facing each other, then turn their bodies and gaze toward you. One agent has a smiling face and a warm vocal tone, with a wide arm gesture. One agent says: “Thank you for waiting, we just need to finish up”. You are at the marked starting area and are about to walk toward the coffee cup behind the agents. Which route class will you use on the approach? Earlier trial and practice responses, exact trial position, exact gap dimensions and the speaking agent’s side when speech occurred are not supplied. The agents were gender-matched to the person’s selected VR gender, but this distribution evidence does not link a gender to this choice. No age, gender, handedness, private history or exact left/right route is assigned here. These omissions do not mean the original participant lacked those observations.
side

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

Two digital colleagues initially stand facing each other, with a table and a coffee cup behind them. The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

At the start of this trial, the agents begin facing each other, then turn their bodies and gaze toward you. One agent has a smiling face and a warm vocal tone, without a wide arm gesture. One agent says: “I’m sorry, but could you hold off just a little?”. You are at the marked starting area and are about to walk toward the coffee cup behind the agents. Which route class will you use on the approach? Earlier trial and practice responses, exact trial position, exact gap dimensions and the speaking agent’s side when speech occurred are not supplied. The agents were gender-matched to the person’s selected VR gender, but this distribution evidence does not link a gender to this choice. No age, gender, handedness, private history or exact left/right route is assigned here. These omissions do not mean the original participant lacked those observations.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

On the earlier approach in this same trial you used a side gap without crossing between the agents; which side is not provided. Which route class will you use on the return? Earlier trial and practice responses, exact trial position, exact gap dimensions and the speaking agent’s side when speech occurred are not supplied. The agents were gender-matched to the person’s selected VR gender, but this distribution evidence does not link a gender to this choice. No age, gender, handedness, private history or exact left/right route is assigned here. These omissions do not mean the original participant lacked those observations.

Two digital colleagues initially stand facing each other, with a table and a coffee cup behind them. The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

At the start of this trial, the agents begin facing each other, then turn their bodies and gaze toward you. One agent has an angry face and an aggressive vocal tone, without a wide arm gesture. One agent says: “You’re being a bit disruptive, could you wait until we’re done here?”. You have reached the cup and now need to return with it to the marked starting position. On the earlier approach in this same trial you used a side gap without crossing between the agents; which side is not provided. Which route class will you use on the return? Earlier trial and practice responses, exact trial position, exact gap dimensions and the speaking agent’s side when speech occurred are not supplied. The agents were gender-matched to the person’s selected VR gender, but this distribution evidence does not link a gender to this choice. No age, gender, handedness, private history or exact left/right route is assigned here. These omissions do not mean the original participant lacked those observations.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.

The person starts about 2.75 metres from the agents, must collect the cup and return to a marked X. There is no prescribed right or wrong way. They move by physically walking while wearing a Meta Quest 2; there is no teleportation or full-body avatar, only visible controllers at the hands. The central path between the agents is shorter and wider than the side passages between either agent and the table. Room boundaries prevent going all the way around the table. The route can differ on approach and return. Predict the reported route class: center means crossing between the two agents at least once on THIS leg; side means using a side gap without crossing that central space on this leg. The side class pools left and right; it does not identify which side was used. Return only center or side. The study has six behavior conditions, each repeated three times in counterbalanced randomized order, after two practice trials (first with no agents, second with agents turning their bodies and gaze without speech). A snack and coffee are offered at the end; no performance-based monetary payoff is specified. Participants can end the study at any time.
